dates_external_review_wire: Core's genuine bodies of the D-149 review contract - members'
corrections (the app's side, member-*) and the console's side (webadmin-*):
- the external list and detail with the external admin contract selector v2;
- the "reviewed, OK" mark;
- the corrections queue, a rejection, and the three approvals (an edit, a cancellation, an official
  update) with `correction_id`;
- the AI re-research of one event, its receipt, its refusals, and a detail in each job state;
- the system's closure of research intakes (`system_closure`) on the intake list, the intake detail
  and the research run detail;
- with their refusals.

Source: Core tests/fixtures/dates_external_review_wire at commit
        c268ae4b ("Capture unknown-organizer events and system closures (D-149)") on Core-B's lane
        branch claude/areyouin-autopub-20261102-core (rebased onto Core-A 3110f2cb; local, not yet
        published when copied on 2026-11-02).

        The corpus was generated at 3e151a15539f5343e0b4f959252b4db41386afeb (manifest.json,
        `source_commit`) by tests/dates_external_review_fixture_dump.php. That is real HTTP through
        public/index.php under PHP's own web server, two captures compared byte for byte. It used the
        console's form transport with its secret and both selectors (manifest.json `selectors.webadmin`).

How:    BYTE COPIES of the 77 bodies and manifest.json of that directory, extracted with
        `git archive c268ae4b tests/fixtures/dates_external_review_wire`; nothing was edited.

        tests/datesExternalReviewWire.test.mts checks every body against the sha256 the manifest
        names and the manifest's `fixture_set_sha256`. It also checks that this directory holds
        nothing else but this note.

        The member-* bodies are the app's side; they are kept so that the copy is whole.

Checked: after Core-B's rebase, its tip 1735a158 holds this directory byte for byte (compared with
        `git archive 1735a158`, 2026-11-02). Before a release, compare these files with the corpus at
        the merged Core tip (the set hash in the test is the check).
